join: strict numeric ID canonicalization, all selected must match safe Weigelt frame
output: n, median and IQR for each safe numeric column by group, standardized log-area and log1p-mainland-distance mean differences, nonempty archip/coordinate fractions
nonselected_label: nonselected Weigelt geography; NOT necessarily mammal-zero
not_measured: selection causal effect on C-R3 or topology, colonization, dispersal
geography_versions: Weigelt GADM v1 island geography and Barreto GADM v3.6-based selection are different frames; not an exact all-island counterfactual
